messages:
pagerbot: [SEV2] GPU queue growth alert — region: us-west-2. gpu-pool-7 queue length sustained >2500 for 8m. throttles engaged, customer 429s increasing. Paging #incidents and oncall.

ben (oncall): ack. I see hosted-api latency climbing and 429/502 spikes. Investigating panels now.

ben (oncall): dashboards -> https://redwood.ops/d/queue-dashboard?panel=gpupool7  latency p50 3s -> 25s, p95 18s -> 120s, 429 rate ~18%.

carmen (runtime): pulling autoscaler/controller logs. Autoscaler loop is spamming create requests and getting failures: 
```
E 11:23:14 autoscaler controller: create_node failed: QuotaExceeded: GPU quota exceeded for region us-west-2
E 11:23:20 autoscaler controller: scale_attempt: reached max_shards (100). retrying
```

alice (infra): checking cloud quotas — confirmed: GPU quota 100/100 in us-west-2. No spare capacity. Also seeing several staging nodes idle but reserved in staging-pool. Will look at rebalancing.

dmitri (eng-sre): while I was grepping logs I noticed a config rollout around 11:10 (commit 2f4d) to runtime config that flipped batching/cache flags. Diff snippet: 
```
- runtime.continuous_batch_window_ms: 50
- runtime.prefix_cache.enabled: true
+ runtime.continuous_batch_window_ms: 500
+ runtime.prefix_cache.enabled: false
```
This would dramatically reduce coalescing and disable the prefix cache — explains the sudden per-request GPU ops spike.

ben (oncall): that matches timing with queue growth. If continuous batching window was increased and prefix cache disabled, single-request token work would go up and autoscaler would be overwhelmed.

carmen (runtime): rolling back the runtime flags now. Applying patch to runtime-config service pointing to previous commit (2a9b). Command: `curl -X POST https://config-api.internal/services/runtime/rollbacks -d '{"commit":"2a9b"}'`

ops-bot: infra: started rebalance job 9876 -> moving 4 GPUs from staging-pool to gpu-pool-7. Job id=9876.

alice (infra): kicked rebalance: `infra-cli rebalance --from staging-pool --to gpu-pool-7 --count 4 --async`. Expect nodes to register in ~3-6m. Also paused non-prod batch cron jobs to free capacity.

ben (oncall): live mitigation checklist done: 1) rollback batching/cache flags 2) throttle low-priority (background) customers via rate-limiter 3) rebalance 4 GPUs from staging -> gpu-pool-7 4) temporarily increase autoscaler max_shards to 110 (if quota allows). Applying throttle now.

carmen (runtime): patch applied — rollback successful. Current runtime config: 
```
runtime:
  continuous_batch_window_ms: 50
  prefix_cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_ms: 600000
```
Config hash: 2a9b -> active. Confirming runtime instances reloaded and prefix cache warmed.

ben (oncall): running quick smoke: `curl -sS https://hosted-api.prod/gen -d '{"prompt":"test"}' | jq .latency` -> replies showing latency dropping for short requests.

monitoring-bot: metric update: gpu-pool-7 queue length: 2524 -> 720 over 6 minutes. 429 rate: 18% -> 2.1%.

dmitri (eng-sre): autoscaler logs now show successful node creation (after rebalance freed capacity): 
```
I 11:34:02 autoscaler: create_node success id=i-0abc1234 (4 GPUs added)
I 11:36:40 autoscaler: scale_loop stable, current_shards=96
```

alice (infra): cloud quota still 100/100; we only freed 4 GPUs by moving from staging. Opening quota request ticket (CLOUD-1284) to increase GPU quota in us-west-2. Also filing an action to not keep high reserve in staging.

ben (oncall): customer impact summary for CS: 3 high-volume customers experienced timeouts on long-running generation jobs (multi-minute). Intermittent 429s for others. No data exfiltration, no model downgrade. CS notified and drafting outreach. Ticket INC-4579 created.

carmen (runtime): root cause preliminary: a runtime config rollout accidentally set continuous_batch_window_ms too large and disabled prefix cache in the same release. This was deployed without a config gating step. Secondary contributors: region GPU quota at 100% and autoscaler had no cross-region fallback.

dmitri (eng-sre): followups assigned: ENG-9821 (config gating + preflight checks), ENG-9822 (alerting on prefix_cache toggles), ENG-9823 (autoscaler fallback policy + cross-region capacity plan), CLOUD-1284 (quota increase). I'll take ownership of the postmortem and remediation.

ben (oncall): handoff: handing to dmitri (eng-sre) for long-term follow-up. I'll stay on call for another hour to make sure metrics are stable. Current status: mitigated.

dmitri (eng-sre): ack — taking over. Timeline + logs saved to /incident/5032134567/artifacts. Will coordinate with runtime and infra for PRs and config reviews.

ops-bot: incident status updated -> mitigated by manual rebalance + config rollback.

pagerbot: Incident mitigated and pager closed by ben (oncall). Runbook note: check continuous batching and prefix cache flags during runtime rollouts; add automated diff alert.

ben (oncall): final notes: rollback PR id=PR-6421, rebalance job=9876, cloud ticket=CLOUD-1284, customer ticket=INC-4579. Marking thread for postmortem. :thumbsup:

dmitri (eng-sre): will schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow. Thanks everyone for rapid coordination.
